data.name: Janour
data.gender_notes: Janour is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'janāna', which means 'to be gentle' or 'graceful'. In Islamic tradition, Janour is a name for a boy who embodies these traits. The name Janour carries the meaning “Graceful, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Janour usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Janour carries spiritual significance as it is associated with the beauty and fragrance of jasmine, which is often used as a symbol of spiritual growth and purification in Islamic culture.
data.etymology: Janour belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Janour total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: جنور
in_arabic.meaning: الضوء الخفيف، النور البسيط، الإشعاع الخفي
in_arabic.long_meaning: جنور هو اسم يعني الضوء الخفيف أو النور البسيط. اشتقت الكلمة من الجذر العربي 'ج-ن-ر' الذي يدل على النور والضوء. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يضيء حياة الآخرين بنوره وبركاته. وردت مشتقات هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سياقات متعلقة بالنور والهداية.

in_urdu.name: جنور

in_hindi.name: जनौर
in_hindi.long_meaning: जनौर का अर्थ है प्रकाश या नूर। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'ज-न-र' से लिया गया है, जो प्रकाश और नूर की ओर इशारा करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपने अस्तित्व से दूसरों के जीवन को रोशन करता है। इस मूल के व्युत्पन्न कुरआन में प्रकाश और मार्गदर्शन के संदर्भ में उल्लेखित हैं।

The name Janour is used across various Muslim cultures to denote a person who brings light, positivity, and guidance to others. Quranic references to this root highlight themes of divine guidance and illumination.
